label: lem:no_small_divisor_prime
title: No smaller prime divisor implies primality
statement:
Let $m\ge 2$.
    If there is no prime $p < m$ with $p\mid m$, then $m$ is prime.
proof: By \ref{lem:lpf_exists}, $m$ has a least prime factor $p$. Since no prime less than $m$ divides $m$, we must have $p = m$, so $m$ is prime.
